notes.title: The Late Halloween Update (v11.19.2018)
notes.notes:
Howdy folks. This large content update was supposed to be released during Halloween, but was delayed more and more due to small little things we kept adding and felt to release it as one big update.  

This change log includes changes from our recent update released on 8th November 2018 too (which was a partial update of v11.19.2018)

[h1]New Characters[/h1]
==================
We have added 2 new 3D characters (Mana Witch and Akasha Succubus), along with quite a lot of user submissions in 2D Workshop.  

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32662029/bb2778c8f9c8554fcd50f51df64068972f40c79e.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32662029/f42a6db7fd233a61a2903f138d0445cc8b92b2a3.png[/img][/url]  [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32662029/19f963d5475f13f5a38adfc8368a515a5e911585.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32662029/076aea42aa70af3ad8313c572346881275f9616e.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32662029/8aa17de3b5bba7ba1cf7bf2e0502ebd736156939.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32662029/b9a76df83e5ef71b6dc6e78b53bd37dd93ff3bd3.png[/img][/url]    [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32662029/47d557d47e996d787856f3b3ecf5275539d8d07b.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32662029/0bf014ac3757dbd45605efa7c5245c08d8615dc1.png[/img][/url] 


[h1]2D Character Engine[/h1]
======================
Long awaited 2D characters can now be used from the Workshop. Just subscribe to a 2D character in workshop and you can start using it in DME as soon as it finishes downloading (in steam).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32662029/414c7211a7c77b7209321b87595f0e72a4a7a0a8.png[/img]

[h1]New Redesigned UI/Menu[/h1]
=========================
Some might have noticed this already, but the old clunky Menu is gone. Instead, now we have a much more minimalist and simpler Menu UI, accessible by clicking the little DME icon/button on bottom right of your screen.  

We will be adding more and more settings and options to configure and customize DME.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32662029/a04823531e29557272c45f2c5f823a5e008b579c.png[/img]


[h1]Take Screenshots[/h1]
=========================
The nature of our program earlier did not let us make use of Steam's Screenshot feature and as such, our users could not share screenshots directly to the Steam Community. 
With this update, we have created our own Screenshot pipeline and users can capture, save and share screenshots to Steam (or else where) by using the F12 key (DME must be in focus, just left click the chara or menu once)


[h1]Full Changelog[/h1]
=========================
-Added new characters - Mana (Witch) and Akasha (Succubus)
-2D Character Engine, cross compatible with shimeji charas/animations
-Redesigned and new Menu UI
-SteamWorkshop2D Sync, copies all subscribed and downloaded workshop items from Steam Directory to local Directory
-New Settings system, should save and persist changed settings
-Fixed random crashing and minimizing when running DME
-Fixed Transparency bug
[b]-Spawn last used character by default, if not available, random it[/b]
-Root motion now uses settings value when spawning new character
-Change MenuToggle button color automatically on hover
-Menu renders above mascots
-Changed Workshop Tool to use 70% screen resolution
[u][b]-Added 2D character size/scale change using mouse scroll when hovering
-Added Menu Toggle button size change using mouse scroll when hovering
-Added 2D character sprite flip using right click when hovering[/b][/u]
[u][b]-Added detection for running processes and to detect if any other Steam game or particular application is running (VLC) to allow for auto disable/hide DME **[/b][/u]
-Right Click Menu Button to hide/show mascots (both 2D/3D)
-Improved Textures for Akasuki/Akane and Akasha/Hara
-Added Character2D card to download more characters in 2d chara selection
-Replaced MenuToggle icon image with glass area filled to allow better clickability
-MenuToggle can be mouse-dragged
-Added TakeScreenshot functionality and to upload to Steam Library (F12 key)
-Other QOL changes and smaller problems reported past few months


** Right now, we have added functionality to detect other running Steam Games and Apps, but are not auto-disabling or hiding mascots (yet). We are still testing this feature and hope to complete it and add it by next update. We are also trying to allow a custom selection/list by user to choose programs/games which should be detected to hide/disable DME to preserve resources (while gaming or watching movie, etc.)

notes.title: Patch v7.9.2018 - Performance Improvement, New Rendering System and QOL changes
notes.notes:

Meanwhile, you can read more about the CPU Usage/Performance and discuss on the same here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/821060/discussions/0/1727575977591835296/

-Main Interface is now borderless with a X/Quit button (to hide it in system tray)
-Settings Menu layout has been improved a bit more
-Some settings has been changed to match new Rendering System
-Added setting to Mute Character Voice/Response sound
-Change minimum/maximum allowed character size
-Character can now be resized by just hovering the mouse over it and using 
  MouseWheel (scroll)

-Motion Animation is now enabled by default
-Hiding Taskbar icon has been disabled temporarily till we find a better way to do it without it affecting CPU usage


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32662029/86fa27be68318b689049d21cac9ddc46e6bc924d.png[/img]


-----------------------------
Don't forget to make your character requests in discussion post linked below, we will be adding some more characters in next update (including re-adding 2D charas)
https://steamcommunity.com/app/821060/discussions/0/1696048786953093031/

notes.title: Patch v7.2.2018 - Motion Animation Update (Settings, Tweaks, Improvements)
notes.notes:
Official Patch notes for the new update pushed today. 
Includes one of our major features "Motion Animation", details of which can be found in our earlier DevLog here:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/821060/announcements/detail/3079781698507886315

-Added Motion Animation setting (can be enabled from settings to allow mascot characters to move in their PlayArea as per their animation)
-Added Mute Audio setting
-Fixed a resolution bug with Ultra Wide Screens, now interface auto-sets the aspect ratio to 16:9 if its bigger than that (important for UWD)
-Removed RTVoice Pro which was being used for the AI-Assistant's welcome message at start of the app. RTVoicePro was making some unknown network service calls (found to be harmless, but removed as a precaution)
-Changed Maximum possible Mascot Character Size to 3 (from 2)
-Mascot Character's rotation and position auto-resets when in Motion Animation mode
-Added Change Language setting to manually change/over-ride the language translations (might require restarting DME app to take effect)
-Change Settings Screen layout to look more organised

Build #2910376

notes.title: DevLog #3 - Big Update tomorrow, New Features and Mascot Charas
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32662029/a9a3a8a7b012af0e3004a1a8f6ea48ccffbec03e.png[/img]

One of our first major Content Update is finally ready for release. Although initially due for release on past Sunday/Monday, it took its sweet time and is now planned to be released this coming [b]Thursday/Friday (24-25 May 2018)[/b].

By taking this extra time, we were able to add some more features and content other than what we initially planned, including a few experimental features like Voice Expressions and Voice Response (for the AI Assistant).  

We will include full list of changes in the official Patch Notes, but here are a few major things coming up.  

 
[h1]Interface/Main Menu[/h1]
--------------------------------------
Its not fully ready yet with some options disabled, but it will be included in the update and those options will be enabled via small daily patches. A few settings are also disabled as we integrate cloud-based setting storage (Steam Cloud).  
We have integrated the initial instructions within the Interface and also added a Mascot Character selection screen.  

Moving forward, we would separate the interactions to a more interactive learning/quick tutorial and would like to Localize them (because lots of text). Till then, we will use this text based approach to include instructions, recent changelog and other messages.

PS: Workshop option in Interface is currently disabled as we will be integrating Steam Workshop this weekend and releasing it in another update over the weekend or next week early. We need some more time to properly integrate it.

[IMG]https://i.imgur.com/DbDxXvF.jpg[/IMG]


[h1]Mascot Character Selection[/h1]
-------------------------------------------------
We have kept the Mascot Selection screen quite simple for now. We wanted to take a functional approach to first version of our interface rather than focusing on Design or UX. 
Moving forward we would like to make the Mascot Selection screen more detailed and interactive with things like filtering mascots based on category, search, tags, and including additional information for each Mascot.

We have categorized the Mascot Characters into 3 levels:

Gold Level (Custom/Rare Animations, interactions and voice responses and expressions)
Silver Level (Normal Animations and Voice Expressions)
Standard Level (Normal Animations)

In coming days, we will add icons and color codes to the Mascot Cards to better differentiate between each type and to let users know what features each Mascot supports. 
In near future, we would like to make the Mascot Cards animated too.

[IMG]https://i.imgur.com/zCrRDsp.jpg[/IMG]


[h1]New Mascot Characters[/h1]
-----------------------------------------
4 new characters have been added, including our very first community submission - [b]Fursona Roly[/b]. In addition, we have decided to remove the old [b]Mecha[/b] Mascot Character due to very limited availability of Animations and it not integrating with our new animation system. 

We will most probably add 2-3 more characters again next week when we release Steam Workshop patch. Let us know what kind of new charas you would like to see via comments below or Community Discussions. 

We plan to add atleast 2 characters each week or two weeks. Initially we will try to add 3-4 characters at every major update and quality patch and bring the default characters available to near 50. 
The current goal we have is to have 50 total characters, with atleast 10 Gold Level characters.
After that we will keep adding curated content from workshop directly to the game, our own custom characters and above all those, you will still be able to use your own custom models (soon) or stream workshop content.


[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32662029/af990629acd258aa8502ee0483714861ecacfa16.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32662029/fa589e6faaca4948c201a2b7ab26a8b06b27ecda.png[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32662029/ac83cdffa3395f88da0700bf988628345ff3236b.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32662029/13cce9c7dfd7e155c0011a5ee38e484c7564c53a.png[/img][/url] 
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32662029/40dfc4105397f1961940b221a0d6e97dc16a63d8.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32662029/ff1850041c4aa9cbed766a1bb5f51f8652ef8f3e.png[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32662029/9a5a5ddc728dfb8e03f51c3ce810d7fc1226df79.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32662029/63225df2733afd0f8db03b8b5a62df926dcb6462.png[/img][/url]



[h1]New Animation System and State Machine[/h1]
-------------------------------------------------------------------
As promised, the star of the update is here. The All New Animation system with [b]40+ new animations[/b], which will be cross compatible with almost all human-body (shaped) characters and allow a much diverse Mascot Interaction.  
The new Animation System will be available for use to all Gold and Silver level Mascot Characters, with only exceptions to oddly-shaped and non-human characters (animals, plants, creatures, etc.).  
The New Animation System will also be available Custom Models feature, allowing you to just supply/use a custom model and [DME] will automatically hook our Animation System to your model(s).  

Along with it comes our new State Machine which is the brain of the Animation System, controlling how animations change and the overall flow of the Mascot's behavior. 
The State Machine will be developed and improved overtime but we are pretty happy with its first version (v1). It provides some good interactions and responses with the Mascot Character.

[IMG]https://i.imgur.com/sf2ZqT0.png[/IMG]


[h1]Experimental Features[/h1]
-----------------------------------------
We have decided to add a few experimental feature previews to this update, mainly the Voice Expressions and Voice Response (for AI-Assistant). 
Currently you will find the following characters make voice expression sounds at certain times (Kurisa, Akasuki, Kiyoshi, Brightfury). 
The AI-Assistant also uses our Voice Response engine to welcome you to [DME] and gives a very small sneak peak of how Mascot Engine will have a future of mixed voice expressions and responses. 
We will be adding more voice expressions and support for more characters overtime. 

Moving forward, we hope to hire our own Voice Artists to get some custom Voice Overs for expressions and responses, this will allow us have unique character-specific voices and tones. 


Feedback and suggestions are welcomed for Experimental Features.
Please use the following Steam Community Discussion: 
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/821060/discussions/0/2828702373010628098/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/821060/discussions/0/2828702373010628098/[/url]
